title: Laptop Feast
description: A bearded man in a blue shirt sits in an office chair at the center of a room, reaching toward an oversized laptop on a stand. The laptop screen displays glowing purple text while dripping yellow and purple liquid onto the wooden floor, surrounded by groups of people at long dining tables with food and bottles.
prompt: A bearded man wearing a blue shirt and dark pants sits in a black office chair in the middle of a large room, reaching his right hand toward an oversized open laptop on a stand. The laptop screen glows with purple text and drips thick yellow and purple liquid onto the wooden floor. On both sides, groups of men, women, and children stand and sit at long wooden dining tables covered with plates of food, bottles, and tablecloths. The background shows colorful dripping paint effects on the walls in a realistic oil painting style.
